Nee Naan Naam

Some songs take us back to where it all began. The first glance, the first conversation, the butterflies of falling in love. Others remind us of the beautiful journey that followed — the laughter, the little disagreements, the unspoken understanding, and the countless moments that slowly became memories.

Nee Naan Naam – Memories Through Music is an intimate, soulful musical experience celebrating love, togetherness, and the stories we carry through life. Through timeless melodies and heartfelt renditions, Aravind Karneeswaran takes you on a nostalgic journey through the different shades of love. With just his voice, a keyboard, and the warmth of an intimate gathering, every song becomes an invitation to remember, reconnect, and sing along.

Whether you've been together for a few years or a lifetime, there is always that one song that belongs to the two of you. A melody that brings back a forgotten moment, a familiar smile, or a beautiful memory. An evening to sit beside the one you love, sing the songs you grew up with, and relive the memories that made you who you are together.

Because some memories are not just remembered. They are sung.

AravindKarneeswaran

The Voice Behind the Emotions.

A passionate singer and performer, Aravind brings music and storytelling together to create memorable experiences. With a love for timeless melodies and contemporary music, he takes audiences on an emotional journey through the many shades of love.

For him, music is more than a performance. It's about connecting hearts, creating memories and making every moment count.

Your invitation to the evening.
